title.narrative: Science and innovation for improving water quality and reducing water pollution

description.narrative:
This workplan supports Member States to strengthen water quality monitoring, assessment and governance through science, innovation and partnerships under IHP-IX. It operationalizes the International Initiative on Water Quality (IIWQ) by integrating digital tools (e.g. remote sensing, citizen science, IoT), advancing knowledge on emerging water quality challenges, and strengthening the science-policy interface.
The workplan focuses on:
- Deployment of the UNESCO Water Quality Portal and digital monitoring tools - Strengthening global water quality data systems and capacities - Advancing research and knowledge on emerging pollutants and climate-related water quality issues - Enhancing partnerships, visibility, and resource mobilization - These actions directly contribute to IHP-IX Outputs on improving water quality (1.8), developing innovative technologies (1.9), advancing data systems (3.3), and strengthening understanding of pollution and integrated water management (4.5, 4.4).
